svg.title: The finite coupling drift comes from the committed path coefficient and the bounded scalar reset, not directly from a formal beta function. At a transition with block length L, put μ = L−1. The determinant calculation on the retained physical path defines a coefficient αN,i with sign appropriate to descent from level i + 1 to i. We explain the logarithm and its uniform remainder. For a fixed color direction, the continuum pole of the relevant second external-momentum coefficient is !
